fusions.name: Ram the Rapids
fusions.desc: A ramming charge carried by a surge of water that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag Spill
fusions.desc: Tips a torrent down from the heights onto a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 2 times at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Stand in the Spate
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 25% and your water resistance by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, a film of water shields you for 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
